verdict.rationale: Cloudflare publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json (confirmed HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key), which covers the AI Gateway API as part of Cloudflare's unified API surface, and also exposes an llms.txt for machine-readable docs discovery. Missing for 10: a dedicated AI-Gateway-specific OpenAPI file (only the platform-wide spec is confirmed) and independent/community corroboration of its completeness for AI Gateway endpoints.
